display.purpose: The arrival greeting only; a single serif moment that opens the day.

headline.purpose: Hub page titles (Saved, Notes, Themes, Your history).

verse.purpose: Scripture itself, centered and balanced; the luminous center of the flow.

title.purpose: Card and theme-tile headings, and the 'Amen.' mark.

body.purpose: Reflection prose, notes, and theme definitions at generous leading.

label.purpose: Uppercase dates, section headers, and kickers; the quiet metadata voice.

micro.purpose: Smallest metadata (card dates, in-card references, journal O/A/P labels); tighter than Label.

card-verse.purpose: The verse inside a compact card (Home 'today' card); one step below the full Verse.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for cards, tiles, and the floating back button.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Higher elevation for prominent or hovered surfaces.

shadows.name: column
shadows.purpose: The single large soft shadow that floats the whole reading column on the canvas.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent), 0 14px 26px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons appear lit from within by the day's accent.

motion.name: ease-calm
motion.purpose: The exponential ease-out for rise, bloom, and step transitions.

motion.name: lift-rise
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance of content on each screen.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The arrival halo and completion marks breathe with an accent ring pulse.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: The Atmosphere glows drift and scale slowly behind content.

motion.name: bloom
motion.purpose: The one authored moment on the Amen screen: the check blooms with a ring.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Cross-fade between devotion steps on remount.

breakpoints.name: column-max
breakpoints.purpose: The reading column never exceeds 384px; the layout is single-column at every size.

components.name: Quiet Button

components.css: .ds-today { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0F6E56) 12%, #FBFAF7); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0F6E56) 35%, transparent); border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38,37,33,0.04), 0 14px 30px -14px rgba(38,37,33,0.14); } .ds-today-glow { position: absolute; top: -3rem; right: -2.5rem; width: 9rem; height: 9rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0F6E56) 26%, transparent), transparent 70%); } .ds-today-kicker { position: relative; display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent, #0F6E56); } .ds-today-verse { position: relative; margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--accent, #0F6E56); } .ds-today-ref { position: relative; display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent, #0F6E56); opacity: 0.65; } .ds-today-cta { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 1.25rem; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #0F6E56); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Atmosphere Layer
components.description: The signature: two drifting radial glows in the day's accent, rendered behind every devotion screen.
components.css: .ds-atmo-demo { position: relative; height: 180px; border-radius: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; background: #FBFAF7; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-atmo { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-atmo::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -34%; left: 50%; width: 150%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 9999px; transform: translate(-50%, 0); background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0F6E56) 24%, transparent) 0%, transparent 62%); animation: ds-drift 15s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-atmo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: -30%; right: -18%; width: 95%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0F6E56) 15%, transparent) 0%, transparent 60%); animation: ds-drift 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; } .ds-atmo-caption { position: relative; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6C6A5F; } @keyframes ds-drift { from { transform: translate(-50%, 0) scale(1); } to { transform: translate(-50%, 3%) scale(1.1); } }

narrative.overview:
Koino is a quiet, reverent daily devotion, and the interface is built to feel like a moment of morning light landing on a warm sheet of paper. The whole product runs on a single idea: each day belongs to an emotional theme, and that theme is expressed not as a label or a colored bar but as atmosphere, a soft, slowly drifting glow in the day's accent color, poured behind the words. You do not read about the mood; you sit inside it.

The system is deliberately calm and unhurried. Type does most of the expressive work: Scripture and prayer are set in a serif reading voice, sized as genuine typographic moments, while everything functional recedes into a clean sans. Depth is warm and gentle, never hard. Motion behaves like breath and light, one authored moment per screen, never a scatter of effects. The result should read as confident and still at the same time: bold in atmosphere and typography, reverent in its chrome.

The one hard rejection is loudness. Koino refuses the gamified, high-contrast, notification-red energy of most habit apps, and it refuses flat colored-card theming where a mood is a solid fill; that is the anti-reference the Atmosphere layer exists to replace.
keyCharacteristics: Each day is a colored atmosphere of light over warm paper, driven by one --accent variable.
A serif voice for Scripture; a quiet sans for everything else.
Warm, soft depth and a floating reading column, never harsh edges or flat fills.
Motion as breath and light: one authored moment per screen, reduced-motion honored.
A fixed brand green for identity chrome, a rotating accent for the day.

rules.name: The Day's Light Rule
rules.body: One screen, one accent. Every themed element keys off a single --accent; you never mix two theme accents on the same screen, and you never restyle a themed element to a static hex. Change the day, and the whole screen re-lights from one variable.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on any colored (accent-tinted) surface is mixed from that hue toward ink, never flat gray. Gray secondary text is only for the neutral paper surface.

rules.name: The Serif-for-Scripture Rule
rules.body: Lora is reserved for the words that carry weight: the verse, the prayer, the greeting, page titles, the Amen, and the user's own saved notes. Inter carries everything that is interface.

rules.name: The Warm-Depth Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is ink-tinted (toward #262521), offset, and soft-blurred. Primary actions additionally carry an accent-tinted glow. No hard shadows, no zero-blur blocks, no gray-black drop shadows.

rules.name: The Atmosphere-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: A theme's presence on screen is light (the drifting Atmosphere glow), never a flat colored background block. When a surface needs the theme color as a fill, it uses the soft accent tint plus a faint corner glow, not a saturated slab.

dos: Do drive every themed element from the single --accent variable, set per screen from theme.accent, so a whole surface re-lights when the day changes.
Do set Scripture, prayer, greetings, page titles, and user notes in Lora; keep Inter for all interface text.
Do express a theme as atmosphere (the drifting glow) plus soft tint, not a flat colored block.
Do tint secondary text on colored surfaces from the hue toward ink, never gray.
Do keep depth warm and soft: offset + blur shadows, accent-glow on primary CTAs, the floating column shadow.
Do give each screen exactly one authored motion moment (breathe, rise, or bloom) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do reserve Koinonia Green (#0F6E56) for identity chrome (active tab, History, brand marks), not for a devotion screen's themed accents.
donts: Don't mix two theme accents on one screen, or hardcode a themed element to a static hex.
Don't use flat, saturated colored fills as a stand-in for theming.
Don't use gray for secondary text on an accent-tinted surface.
Don't introduce hard or zero-blur shadows, or a colored border-left heavier than 1px, as structure.
Don't add a new font or a new radius/shadow primitive; the paper world is complete as defined.
Don't raise the volume: no gamified reds, urgency badges, or shame-based missed states.
